title: Hello World

content:
Hi, I’m enyuanzwerver I’m a DevOps Engineer based in the Netherlands, passionate about infrastructure, homelabs, and building things that actually work in production.
What I do Currently I work as a Devops Engineer for the Dutch National Police.
Outside of work I run a self-hosted Kubernetes cluster on bare-metal hardware, where I experiment with production-grade tooling and document what I learn along the way.
My stack Kubernetes — kubeadm on bare metal GitOps — FluxCD for automated deployments Ingress — Traefik reverse proxy Observability — Prometheus + Grafana Secrets — Sealed Secrets Tunnel — Cloudflare Tunnels for zero-trust public exposure This site — Hugo + PaperMod, built and deployed automatically via GitHub Actions What I write about Homelab builds and infrastructure decisions Things I learn on the job Journey progress and reflections Get in touch Feel free to reach out on LinkedIn or GitHub.
